category: file host (freemium, free uploads without an account)

free_tier.stated: Free User: Unlimited Storage, download speed limited, advert supported, files kept for 20 days, maximum file upload size 20.00 GB.
free_tier.notes: The FAQ states uploading and downloading is free for all users; no byte allowance for downloads is printed.

per_object_cap.stated: Each file you upload must be less than 20 GB in size for free/non accounts or less than 20 GB in size for premium accounts.
per_object_cap.notes: bytes = 20 x 1024^3; the cap is the same on the free and the premium plans.

retention.stated: Free/non accounts files are kept for 20 days. Premium accounts files are kept for 100 days.
retention.notes: The Vip plan keeps files 100 days; the Pro plan 30 days.

egress.terms: Free downloads run at a limited speed; premium members get no waiting time and direct downloads. No byte allowance is printed for either plan.

interface_detail: Web upload with a register_non_user upload route. No API page was read.
tooling: Browser only as read. No rclone backend found.
chaining: 20 GB per file with no account is large for a free host, but 20-day retention and a speed-limited free download make it a hand-off point, not an archive.

limits.value: 20 GB per file on every plan
20 days for free and non-account files; 30 days Pro; 100 days Vip
download speed limited on the free plan; premium has maximum download speed

binding_note: Files vanish after 20 days free; the 20 GB cap is the same on the paid plans, so the paid plans buy retention and speed, not size.

identity_cost.detail: The FAQ prices 'free/non accounts' files at 20 days, so upload works without registering; the homepage offers both Upload and Register.

reliability_note: The Pro plan keeps files 30 days and the Vip plan 100 days, so the cheaper paid plan keeps files for less time than the dearer one.
confidence_note: Plan list, FAQ and homepage read on the vendor pages on 2026-11-03. The billing period of the $1.49 and $2.99 prices is not printed.

evidence.proved: the free plan keeps files 20 days
every plan lists a 20.00 GB maximum upload

evidence.quote: Free/non accounts files are kept for 20 days. Premium accounts files are kept for 100 days.
evidence.proved: non-account uploads exist and retention is 20 days against 100 days

price_per_tb_month: USD 1.49 (Pro) and USD 2.99 (Vip); billing period and volume not stated
notes: Cheapest paid plan is Pro at USD 1.49, which adds maximum download speed and removes adverts.
